articles.title: Inquest into death of police-involved shooting of Jamal Francique shown videos
articles.summary: The inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga in early 2020 is watching videos showing the officers around his wrecked car after the shooting.

articles.summary: Toronto police have released images of three suspects as they investigate an alleged assault with a weapon aboard a TTC subway train that left a victim injured earlier this week. articles.title: 13-year-old boy charged in daylight Scarborough home invasion
articles.summary: The Toronto Police Service (TPS) says a 13-year-old boy is in custody following an alleged armed home invasion where the accused threatened the homeowner with a knife and a noxious substance. Officers were notified of a break and enter in the Kingston Road and Danforth Road area just after 1:30 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 17. […]

articles.title: ‘Do not discount the Blue Jays’: Toronto reportedly in the mix for prized free-agent Skubal as decision looms
articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays met with prized free-agent starting pitcher Tarik Skubal on Tuesday, according to ESPN’s Jeff Passan, as the ace reportedly gets closer to a decision on where he’ll sign. articles.title: From frontlines to city hall: Newly elected advocates determined to fix Toronto's housing, homelessness crisis
articles.summary: Toronto's newly elected city council includes well-known housing rights activists and advocates supporting the homeless population. They say they're bringing their lived experiences and expertise to the council table.

articles.title: Can Canada remain an auto-building country?
articles.summary: The future of Canada’s auto-building sector remains the crux of concern, as the fallout of Stellantis’ Brampton, Ont., plant sale to Canadian defence contractor, Roshel plays out on both economic and political fronts. articles.title: 'Bring it on,' Mississauga mayor says as real estate firms appeal city's data centre ban
articles.summary: Mississauga's new mayor says he's prepared to fight against U.S-based Prologis and Montcrest Asset Management, two companies that are challenging the city's decision to block a data centre project at the Ontario Land Tribunal.

articles.title: Inquest into death of Jamal Francique, who was shot by police in Mississauga in 2020 paused for a day
articles.summary: The coroner's inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago is on hold for a day. The presiding officer says counsel are dealing with the proposed submission of new material not previously provided to the inquest.

articles.title: SIU investigating after Durham police involved in crash at Hwy 401 ramp
articles.summary: A 53-year-old woman has a serious, non-life threatening injury after a three-vehicle collision involving a police vehicle in Whitby on Sunday, the province's police watchdog says.
